newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: INSTANT VIEW - Tenaga 8.3 pct tariff hike.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Tenaga 8.3 pct tariff hike.

text.p: Following are views by analysts on Malaysian electricity utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd receiving approval for a 8.3 percent hike in its power tariffs.
SHARINAZ SHAFIE, POWER ANALYST AT ABN AMRO HOARE GOVETT

"We were expecting around an eight percent (tariff hike), so the 8.3 percent hike was slightly better than expected. We had a 'sell' on the stock at 12.90 ringgit, but we are upgrading it to a hold now because any news like this will be better for the market and especially for Tenaga.

"I don't think it's a buy because it is still trading at a 30 percent premium to the market, although the sentiment has improved. Based on 1998 earnings, it is now trading at a price-earnings multiple of 18.4 timeS, compared to a market P/E of around 14 times."
